summary: Read your own profile
description: Available to every authenticated OPEN account, including accounts with no permissions. Identity and workspace come from current persisted authentication. No other user's profile is returned.

summary: Update your own names, bio and birth date
description: Allowlisted partial update; unknown fields are rejected. Omitted fields retain values, null clears individual components. Name changes must leave one nonempty component; bio-only and empty updates preserve legacy names. No phone, username, role, permissions, lifecycle or membership editing. Concurrent name changes may return 409; reread before retrying.

summary: Read your stored Telegram link status
description: Available to current authenticated OPEN accounts, including zero-permission accounts. No request selectors, Telegram identifiers, phone numbers or credentials. Reads only the stored verification record; does not contact Telegram or offer link/recovery mutations.

summary: List workspace users
description: Requires users.read. Results are ordered by newest account first.

summary: Create a pending workspace user
description: Requires users.manage. The new identity starts in PENDING. Sharing the matching Telegram contact links the bot identity; successful platform registration later changes the status to OPEN.

summary: Ban a workspace user
description: Requires users.manage. Banned users cannot sign in, refresh tokens, or use an existing access token.

summary: Delete a workspace user
description: Requires users.manage. This is a soft deletion: the identity remains auditable with DELETED status, and every active session token is revoked.

summary: Receive Telegram contact, task and inline-keyboard updates
description: Authenticated Telegram webhook for private-chat contact verification, project/model selection, tasks, session updates and file downloads. Commands use the linked account's current permissions. Invalid or irrelevant updates receive 200.

summary: Read your shared manual availability
description: OPEN human self access, including zero workspace permissions. Null means unset; no selected default, expiry or connection presence. One value for everyone; legacy STATUS audiences have no effect. Custom text and badge symbols remain unsupported.

summary: Set or clear your shared manual availability
description: Explicitly shares the selected Available/Away/Busy value with everyone, including anonymous profile viewers. Null clears to unset. Exact request/revision retry returns its frozen receipt; changed reuse or stale revision conflicts. 500/503 or lost transport does not prove rollback: read the same operation or retry unchanged. No agent execution, approval bypass, privacy edit, custom text, symbol or presence inference.

summary: Reconcile your own status change
description: Fresh OPEN self scope. Frozen human actor and result only; historical receipt does not reapply status or imply current value. No public actor history.

summary: Read one shared manual availability
description: Same current value for everyone, including anonymous, cross-workspace and owner viewers. Only OPEN accounts resolve; missing/inactive profiles share404. Supplied invalid authentication rejects. Legacy STATUS audience records do not hide or vary this value. No online/offline, last-active time, workspace, actor history or private profile fields.

summary: Search mixed public accounts and your authorized workspace, or expand its account children
description: No roster/admin grant is added. Only your current workspace is discoverable; foreign public accounts omit affiliation. Saved complete sets and parent state are independent of page/query. Cursors are live keyset pagination, not a frozen database snapshot.

summary: Set or clear your private contact alias
description: Requires an existing contact. Does not rename the account or change audience grants.

summary: Save staged profile fields and audiences atomically
description: All profile fields and supplied audience replacements commit together. Omitted fields retain values. Contacts are separate explicit Add/Remove mutations, never changed by this Save. Validation errors and serialization conflicts reject the entire request; after 503 or an unknown transport outcome reread self and privacy before retrying.

summary: Read your field audiences
description: Missing policy is NO_ONE. Avatar/status policies are foundations only; their data writes and delivery are not implemented.

summary: Atomically replace your field audience
description: Complete recipient sets. CUSTOM unions explicit accounts and current workspace membership. Counts describe selected entries. EVERYONE includes anonymous viewers. CONTACTS means accounts in your directed Contacts list. Use the separately authorized audience-picker endpoint for discovery. On concurrent conflict, reread before retrying.

summary: Read your directed Contacts entries
description: Owner-only account IDs and timestamps. Private aliases are managed separately; adding a contact has no reciprocal acceptance or notification.

summary: Add a known account to your Contacts
description: Idempotent unilateral grant. Does not change the target's Contacts.

summary: Remove a known account from your Contacts
description: Idempotently removes your directed Contact grant and its private alias. UUID matching is case-insensitive, including historical text spellings; all matching grants owned by you are removed. Other owners' grants and independent audience policies remain unchanged. Contacts-only disclosure stops on the next profile read.

summary: Read one coherent self profile edit baseline
description: OPEN human self, including zero permissions. One snapshot of profile, policies, shared availability and aggregate revision. Contacts remain separate explicit operations. No actor history.

summary: Commit the complete staged Profile Save atomically
description: Use the edit revision and a UUIDv4 requestId. Supported profile fields, supplied audiences and optional availability commit together with one private receipt. Omitted fields retain values; null clears supported fields. Availability is shared with everyone regardless of legacy STATUS policy. Receipt is historical acknowledgment only; reread edit state for current values. Exact retries do not reapply. Existing PUT /users/me/profile and standalone status contracts remain compatible. Done stages locally; pre-submit Cancel sends nothing. No contacts, avatar uploads, role edits or agent execution.

summary: Reconcile your whole Profile Save
description: Fresh OPEN human owner and workspace checks. Minimal immutable acknowledgment, never old private content or current-state proof. A 404 while a request is still in flight is not proof of failure.

summary: Look up public identity and viewer-visible profile fields by username
description: Authentication is optional; supplied invalid credentials reject. Missing policies hide fields. Public reads never include phone, permissions, workspace affiliation, contacts or aliases. Only available OPEN accounts resolve; other states and missing accounts return the same 404.

summary: Read public identity with server-evaluated biography and independent birthday parts
description: Public views, including the owner, follow audiences. Private self data stays on /users/me. Avatar/status delivery remains unimplemented.

summary: Send a registration OTP through Telegram
description: Accepts only a phone number and UZ, RU, or EN locale. The phone must belong to a pre-created PENDING identity whose matching contact was shared with the Telegram bot. The formal Telegram message displays the code as a spoiler and tells the user it is valid for one minute; the technical expiry window is five minutes.

summary: Verify a registration OTP
description: Verifies the newest unconsumed registration code. A code is technically valid for five minutes and permits at most five failed attempts. Success returns a single-use cryptographically random registration token valid for ten minutes.

summary: Check username availability
Complete platform registration
description: Send the temporary registration token as `Authorization: Bearer <temporaryToken>`. The token is purpose-bound and single-use. A successful request stores the normalized unique username and scrypt password hash, then changes the user status from PENDING to OPEN.

summary: Sign in with username and password
Refresh an access token
Send a password-reset OTP through Telegram
description: Uses the same localized Telegram verification controls as registration, but requires an OPEN account.

summary: Verify a password-reset OTP
Set a new password
description: Send the temporary password-reset token as `Authorization: Bearer <temporaryToken>`. Success consumes the token and revokes every refresh token for the account.

summary: Get the caller's current effective authorization
Read a role permission edit snapshot with workspace authorization revision
Read user role assignments with workspace authorization revision
Replace a user's role assignments
List the assignable permission catalog
List workspace roles with permissions
Create a custom workspace role
Update role display metadata
Delete an unassigned custom role
Replace a role's permission set
Read a workspace-scoped mutation revision without a read grant
List configuration templates
Create a template with draft version 1
Read effective template upload limits
description: Management permission required; metadata does not imply storage health or draft writability. Both per-file and per-version limits remain enforced.

summary: Get a template and its visible versions
Update template metadata
Clone the latest published version into a new draft
Archive a configuration template
Atomically replace draft folders and ordered command stages
Upload and register an immutable MinIO-backed file
Change a draft file destination path
Remove a file registration from a draft
Validate and immutably publish a draft version
Read a workspace-scoped mutation revision without a read grant
List active workspace departments
description: Active departments only by default. includeArchived=true is honored only with departments.manage. Known archived IDs remain readable within the caller workspace.

summary: Create a department and provision its home directory
Get an active or archived department in the caller workspace
Update an unused department home or its name
description: Omitted fields retain their values. Null clearing is unsupported and returns 400 before provisioning or writes. Empty PATCH is supported.

summary: Make a department the workspace default
Archive a non-default department
Create group metadata
description: Every current OPEN human account may create metadata without global permissions. Creator becomes initial owner. No invitations, memberships, history, admins or agents are created. Reuse requestId and normalized name for durable replay; changed input returns 409.

summary: Read your group creation outcome
description: Creator-only frozen initial metadata. Unknown or other creator request IDs return opaque 404. Current OPEN authentication required.

summary: Read your created group metadata
description: Creator-only. Roles or workspace membership grant no access. Metadata is platform scoped; current workspace is checked for active authentication only. No participant or conversation projection.

summary: Check API health
description: Returns once the HTTP application is accepting requests.

summary: Check PostgreSQL and MinIO readiness
Archive an owned project without removing its context
description: Fresh dedicated permission and creator ownership required. Stable requestId and original If-Match permit readback by identical retry. Archived projects are read-only, hidden from ordinary lists. No files, task history, execution status or membership are removed. No restore action is defined.

summary: Read initial-enqueue recovery state
description: Current member/authorized administrator management scope. Distinguishes no attempt from an existing failed attempt and returns the pinned template without private logs/paths.

summary: Ensure the project's first pinned setup attempt is registered
description: Failed/initializing project with no attempts only. Repeating the same project/template returns attempt 1 without retrying or duplicating it. Registration is not execution completion. On unknown outcome, read recovery state and reconcile the same project/template; never recreate the project.

summary: List project initialization attempts
Get initialization status and bounded step logs
Replay bounded persisted initialization events
description: At most 100 events per page, in contiguous sequence order. Advance after using the last returned sequence; a full page may have more. Current account, workspace, grants and project read scope are checked in the same snapshot. Unavailable sequences return 409 INITIALIZATION_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.

summary: Replay and stream initialization events
description: Persisted polling eliminates the replay-to-live handoff gap. Use after or Last-Event-ID (must agree if both supplied), then deduplicate by initialization/sequence. Each batch rechecks current account, workspace, grants and project scope. Stream ends at token expiry, access loss or transport error; reconcile with REST. No worker launch or cancellation is performed by subscribing.

summary: Cancel a queued or running initialization
Retry the latest failed initialization from clean staging
Discover eligible project member candidates
description: Current projects.members.manage plus project membership or projects.manage-all required; users.read is not needed. Rechecked persisted authorization every page. Only current OPEN accounts belonging to the project's workspace; minimal public identity and existing-project membership flag. Default50/max100; literal case-insensitive search; UUID ascending. Mutable roster continuation, not a complete roster/count or grant. Archived/deleting projects return409. Add-member rechecks eligibility independently; picker selection grants nothing.

summary: Submit identifiable project creation without replaying filesystem work
description: Keep requestId through response loss. Repeated identical submissions only read outcome. UNRESOLVED requires inspection, never automatic CLEAR or a new request identity. Legacy POST /projects remains available without submission readback.

summary: Read the caller's own creation outcome without project-list access
description: Current projects.create required. Foreign workspace/owner and unknown identities are 404; absence does not prove an earlier submission cannot commit.

summary: List accessible projects
description: Current projects.read is required. Ordinary lists exclude archived projects; lifecycle=archived returns only archives with the same access checks. Callers with projects.read-all receive all matching workspace projects; others receive membership/public-read projects. isMember reports only persisted membership. Authorization, scope and viewer relationship share one snapshot.

summary: Create a project
description: Requires projects.create. Selects the workspace default department when departmentId is omitted. Existing directories require an explicit KEEP choice here; CLEAR must use POST /projects/creation-submissions with a client-generated requestId (legacy CLEAR returns 428). Empty projects become ready immediately; a published template registers asynchronous setup. The creator becomes the first member. Use keyed creation-submissions for original-response readback; this legacy route does not supply a client submission identity.

summary: Get project details
description: Current projects.read plus project read scope. Members/read-all callers receive the existing member list; public-read nonmembers receive metadata with members omitted. isMember independently reports the current caller's actual membership in the same snapshot; it is not an access grant or personalization ranking.

summary: Update project settings
description: Requires projects.update and project membership unless projects.manage-all is also granted.

summary: Add a project member
description: Requires projects.members.manage and project membership unless projects.manage-all is also granted. New members must be OPEN accounts in this workspace. Existing inactive memberships are returned unchanged until explicitly removed; they grant no active account authority.

summary: Remove a project member
description: Requires projects.members.manage and project membership unless projects.manage-all is also granted.

summary: Create a project folder
description: Available to project members and administrators. Creates parent directories as needed.

summary: List a project directory
description: Available to members, administrators, and users granted workspace read access. Omit `path` to list the project root.

summary: Read effective project upload configuration
description: Same membership/admin and READY gates as uploads; does not read storage or imply storage health. Unavailable requests return errors, never client defaults.

summary: Upload a project file
description: Available to project members and administrators. Uses multipart form data; the destination folder must already exist. Uploads never overwrite an existing file.

summary: Move or rename a project file or folder
description: Available to project members and administrators. The destination parent must exist; moves into self, overwrites, traversal, and symbolic links are rejected.

summary: List protected file extensions
Append a protected file extension
Update a protected file extension (owner only)
Remove a protected file extension (owner only)
Move a file or folder to the recoverable project trash
Confirm deletion of a protected project file or folder
Inspect a deletion outcome and repair its database state without moving bytes
List recoverable project trash items
Restore a recoverable project trash item
Read recent deletion state
description: Owner/member within current workspace; after project removal only the persisted owner or requester within the resource's saved workspace. Latest 100 requests and audits, newest first. Unknown legacy audit scope fails closed.

summary: Request permanent project deletion
Reconcile a known deletion request
description: Same scope as deletion history; works after request/project removal through the durable audit. Does not perform filesystem work, reissue tokens or confirm deletion.

summary: Owner approval and deletion-token preflight
Owner chooses whether live project sessions should wait or be interrupted
Cancel an outstanding project deletion request
Submit the owner Telegram token and permanently delete the project
Download a project file
description: Available to members, administrators, and users granted workspace read access. Directories and symbolic links cannot be downloaded.

summary: Get the legacy default projects home
description: Legacy administrator endpoint. Returns the active default department home, departmentId and revision. New integrations should use the Departments API.

summary: Set the legacy default projects home
description: Requires the current quoted If-Match revision and departmentId from GET. Updates the active default home under the department/project lock; a changed default returns 409. The home cannot change after the department owns a project. Preserve entered data and reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying.

summary: List sessions for your assigned tasks
description: Current OPEN/workspace/sessions.read and assigned-manager scope only; no read-all/admin bypass. Explicit statuses and optional task/project filters, bounded keyset paging by createdAt/id descending. projectId requires current project membership and the task's explicit board association, independent of saved execution context. Only project-filtered items include current task id/title/projectId; global and task-only summaries keep their minimal shape. No project label, process liveness or complete active count is implied. Each page reevaluates status/assignment/membership; titles are current per page and asOf is a creation cutoff, not a retained snapshot.

summary: Start a managed coding session
description: Requires sessions.create. Creates the session immediately and starts its first turn asynchronously. Watch the SSE endpoint for runner events and completion.

summary: Validate an authorized session directory without creating a session
description: Assigned task manager only. Does not provision paths or list roots. Validation is an observation and is repeated at launch; external filesystem races remain possible.

summary: Resolve an authorized selected project for session setup
description: Current project member or projects.manage-all only. Returns minimal project/directory readiness; canStartSession also requires an assigned task. No directory listing or model/sandbox capability expansion.

summary: List managed session models and thinking efforts
description: Returns the current managed catalog. Clients must only offer each model's supportedReasoningEfforts and use defaultReasoningEffort when no effort is chosen.

summary: Get a session and its turns
description: Available only to the task's assigned manager.

summary: Start a follow-up turn
description: Requires sessions.manage. The session must not already have a running turn. The turn is persisted before asynchronous launch. Reuse the same requestId and prompt to reconcile an uncertain submission without relaunching.

summary: Reconcile a known follow-up submission
description: Assigned manager only. Readable with sessions.manage; does not require sessions.read. No automatic prompt replay after restart.

summary: Interrupt the active local runner
description: Requires sessions.manage. Persists an interruption request; repeated requests return its outcome. Signal acceptance is not stop confirmation.

summary: Read bounded persisted session history
description: Assigned manager only. Snapshot and high-water sequence share one transaction; advance using nextCursor. Explicit omission markers preserve ordering. No actor field represents the viewer as event author.

summary: Replay and stream committed session events
description: Persisted polling with no history-to-live gap. Use after or Last-Event-ID (identical if both supplied). Reconnect after the last delivered sequence and deduplicate by sequence. Current account/grants/assignment are checked each batch. Stream ends at access-token expiry or authorization loss; transport errors require REST reconciliation.

summary: Explicitly link an owned task to one project board
description: Current project membership, tasks.create and task creator ownership required. Initial revision0 and explicit same-board status. Owner becomes first human assignee; AI manager/criteria/status/sessions remain unchanged. No project transfer or historical inference.

summary: Edit an owned task's title, description or human priority
description: Fresh owner plus tasks.details.manage and project membership. Assignment/admin/AI manager does not grant definition edits. Allowlisted fields only. Optional human priority URGENT/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW; omit to retain, null clears; runner status remains independent.

summary: Replace an owned task's human assignee set
description: At most100 assignees; newly added staff must be OPEN same-project members. Existing inactive relationships may remain only for explicit checklist handoff, never action access. Reassign/remove checklist items before removing their assignee. Execution manager is independent.

summary: Move an assigned task between its project workflow columns
description: Current task assignment and dedicated move permission; ownership/read-all/admin does not bypass assignment. Never updates runner Task.status.

summary: Append a single-assignee checklist item to an owned task
description: Optional independent item deadline uses the task calendar/timezone contract. Omission or null starts without one. Owner, current project membership and checklist management permission required.

summary: Edit an owned task's checklist definition
description: One existing task assignee per item. Reassignment preserves existing completion attribution/history; it does not claim a new completion. Optional deadline replaces the whole item value; omission retains it, null clears it. Uses the task calendar/timezone contract without changing task deadline or completion.

summary: Remove a checklist definition from an owned task
description: Human audit retains the removed item and completion history. No task/session deletion occurs.

summary: Check or uncheck only the caller's assigned checklist item
description: Fresh current item assignee, task assignment, project membership and dedicated completion permission. Task owner/manager/admin and other assignees cannot complete it.

summary: Reorder every checklist item of an owned task
description: Current OPEN owner, project membership and checklist management permission. Submit every current item exactly once. Preserves IDs, titles, assignees, deadlines and completion. Shared human revision and durable audit/retry contract; archived or deleting projects reject new writes.

summary: Append a plain human comment to an assigned task
description: Current task assignment, project membership and dedicated comment permission. No attachments, automatic execution imports, mentions/notifications or external fetching.

summary: Read bounded comments as a current project member
Read bounded human task history as a current project member
Read a saved human action outcome without repeating it
description: Current project membership suffices for readback even after assignment changes. Mutation retries still require their fresh action authority.

summary: Read deliberately linked human tasks as a current project member
description: Membership is sufficient; no tasks.read grant or task assignment is needed. Public project access and execution read-all do not substitute. Archived projects remain readable by current members. Current workflow label/color/palette is included without board management authority. Order: Urgent, High, Medium, Low, unset, then createdAt descending and id descending. Excludes execution criteria/status, sessions, transcripts, credentials and filesystem paths. No historical links are inferred. This compatibility list remains unpaginated.

summary: Query bounded human tasks with scoped summaries
description: Current OPEN project membership is sufficient. Filters, counts and current public assignee identities share one page snapshot; no execution content or private profile lookup. Default50/max100, highest priority/newest creation first. Exact deadline sorting puts timed values first by pinned instant, then date-only by calendar date, unset last. Direction applies within each bucket. Existing deadlineDate calendar comparator and array list remain compatible. Generation changes return409 on continuation; refresh. Public names/lifecycle are current per-page display metadata and do not advance task query generation.

summary: Read one human task within current project membership
Read workflow metadata for a readable project
description: Dedicated board permission plus existing project read scope. No task roster, execution status or session data. Each project has one board; columns are independent human workflow.

summary: Read the status-management snapshot
description: Requires current dedicated status permission plus actual project membership or projects.manage-all. Existing project editing/read-all is not a substitute. Provides revision for If-Match without granting task reads.

summary: Create a workflow status
description: Stable request identity and board revision; appended after existing statuses, maximum100. No role or project-edit grant is inferred.

summary: Rename or recolor a stable workflow status
Move referenced tasks atomically and remove a status
description: Occupied status requires an explicit same-board replacement. Tasks move and removal/order/revision/audit commit together. The last status cannot be removed. Never changes runner execution status.

summary: Replace the complete ordered status list
description: Every current status exactly once; order does not change identity or completion meaning.

summary: Reconcile a workflow mutation by stable request identity
description: Saved outcomes never reapply operations and always recheck current management scope.

summary: Read bounded workflow configuration history
description: Exclusive revision cursor; scoped to this board, no task IDs, paths or request hashes.

summary: Read a task deadline
description: Existing task read scope: assigned manager or current tasks.read-all within workspace. Null means unset/cleared. Calendar-only dates are not UTC instants; timed values retain the pinned instant, local clock, zone and explicit offset.

summary: Set or clear a task deadline atomically
description: Stable requestId and original If-Match required. Date-only remains a calendar date. Timed deadlines require local HH:mm, IANA timeZone and matching explicit utcOffset; nonexistent local times and mismatched offsets reject, repeated hours are explicitly selected by offset. Null clears. No notification/schedule, runner status or task assignment is changed.

summary: Read an authorized task deadline edit snapshot
description: Dedicated deadline permission plus current ownership/membership for linked human tasks, or current execution-manager identity for unlinked tasks. Read-all is not edit authority; manage-only users may read this narrow snapshot.

summary: Reconcile a deadline change without replay
Read bounded deadline history in current deadline edit scope
Create a task
description: Requires current tasks.create. The authenticated user becomes creator and execution manager. Optional requestId atomically records a frozen creation receipt; exact retries replay201, changed input conflicts409. Omit requestId for legacy non-idempotent creation. No board link, human assignment or execution starts. After an unknown response, read the same request or retry unchanged.

summary: List visible tasks
description: Requires tasks.read. Callers with tasks.read-all receive all workspace tasks; other callers receive tasks assigned to them. Each result includes manager fullName and a zero-or-one-element sessions array selected by session createdAt DESC. The summary contains only id, status and createdAt and does not grant session-detail access.

summary: Read your frozen task creation outcome by request ID
description: Current OPEN workspace and tasks.create are required; tasks.read is not. Caller/workspace scope is server-derived. Unknown/other-owner requests return404. No query selectors. Frozen initial values are not current task state; receipt lifetime follows the retained task.

summary: Read a visible task by stable identity
description: Requires current tasks.read and current workspace scope. Without tasks.read-all, only the assigned manager can read the task; creator identity and project/role labels grant no bypass. Authorization and task projection share one database snapshot. Missing, foreign-workspace and unassigned tasks return the same 404. Returns only existing task fields, manager fullName and the zero-or-one latest-created session summary; this grants no session detail or transcript access.
